changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[RuleImplementations_Results] AS select A.ObjectId as RuleID, 1 as Threshold, null as RuleImplementationID, 'default' as RuleImplementation, null as RuleResultID, RR.EffectiveDate, RR.CreatedOn, RR.RunDate, RR.PassCount as RowsPassed, RR.FailCount as RowsFailed, case when [PassCount]=(0) AND [FailCount]=(0) then (0) else CONVERT([decimal](18,17),CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))/(CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))+CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[FailCount],(0))),(0)) end as [PassFraction], case when [PassCount]=(0) AND [FailCount]=(0) then (0) when [PassCount]=(0) AND [FailCount]<>(0) then (1) else CONVERT([decimal](18,17),CONVERT([decimal](18,15),CONVERT([decimal](18,3),(1),(0))-CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))/(CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))+CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[FailCount],(0))),(0)),(0)) end as [FailFraction], cast(1 as bit) as Passed from AssetResult RR inner join Asset A on A.uid = RR.OwningAssetUid
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM SYS.TABLES WHERE NAME = 'AssetResult' AND is_node = 1) BEGIN CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[RuleImplementations_Results] AS with results as (select AR.Uid resultUid, AR.Passcount, AR.FailCount, AR.EffectiveDate, AR.RunDate, AR.PassFraction, AR.CreatedBy, AR.CreatedOn, AR.UpdatedBy, AR.UpdatedOn, AN.Uid as RuleUid from AssetResult AR, assetResultedge ARE, graph.AssetNode AN where Match (AN -(ARE)-> AR) and ARE.Class = 1 ) select A.ObjectId as RuleID, 1 as Threshold, null as RuleImplementationID, 'default' as RuleImplementation, null as RuleResultID, RR.EffectiveDate, RR.CreatedOn, RR.RunDate, RR.PassCount as RowsPassed, RR.FailCount as RowsFailed, case when [PassCount]=(0) AND [FailCount]=(0) then (0) else CONVERT([decimal](18,17),CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))/(CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))+CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[FailCount],(0))),(0)) end as [PassFraction], case when [PassCount]=(0) AND [FailCount]=(0) then (0) when [PassCount]=(0) AND [FailCount]<>(0) then (1) else CONVERT([decimal](18,17),CONVERT([decimal](18,15),CONVERT([decimal](18,3),(1),(0))-CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))/(CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[PassCount],(0))+CONVERT([decimal](18,3),[FailCount],(0))),(0)),(0)) end as [FailFraction], cast(1 as bit) as Passed from results RR inner join Asset A on A.uid = RR.RuleUid END
